summary_en: ¥60.0M upper limit, 50,000 shares, 2.42% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury), ToSTNeT-3 market purchase, Aug 19 – Nov 30, 2026. Stated rationale: capital efficiency and shareholder value enhancement.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: AHC GROUP INC. announced on August 18, 2026 that its Board of Directors has resolved to acquire up to 50,000 of its own ordinary shares (2.42% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum of ¥60.0 million. The purchase will be executed via ToSTNeT-3 (off-exchange dark pool trading) on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between August 19 and November 30, 2026. The implied price ceiling is ¥1,200 per share. The company stated that the buyback supports its capital-efficiency strategy and shareholder-value enhancement objectives, to be executed in response to evolving business conditions. As of July 31, 2026, the company held 69,045 treasury shares against a base of 2,066,825 outstanding shares (ex-treasury).
